Name: StardewValley AutoBackup
Author: CloudTronX
Description:
Sometimes you will think you done something wrong before, so you may want to restart your game from that day (like you forgot to collect battery on a light day, and the whole summer doesn't rain except that day). But you already sleep and saved, or that's 4-5 days ago, so you only can buy batteries from the traveling car, and you may not lucky enough to get it.

[b]This application is to solve this problem! It will auto backup your game when you sleep, and you can restore it any time![/b] 

[b]How it works?[/b]
[list=1]
[*]It will keep running on your computer and create threads to check your save folder.
[*]If it found any files in the save folder changed the last modify time, it means you sleep and the game wrote something to the file(save).
[*]And then it will copy the directory to the Backup folder, and name it as "<original_name>_Y<years_in_game>_<season>_<day_of_the_month>"
[*]Finish, back to step 1.
[/list]
[b]Support:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]StardewValley v1.0 - v1.5 (Tested on 1.4.5)
[*]Windows 10 (Win7 need to install a DLL) x64 (I will build x86 version at soon)
[*]Mac OS X 10.9+ (Support Big Sur), need Python3.6+ and rumps. (pip3 install rumps)
[/list][b]Usage: [/b]
[list=1]
[*]Open "StardewValleyAuoBackup.exe" before you play the game.
[*]You can find the application in Tray(Windows) or the menu bar(macOS).
[*]Right-click the icon you can find more options.
[*]When it backed up, you can see a notification.
[*]When you need to restore, please backup your current save and find these old save files in "%APPDATA%\StardewValley\Backup\" (Windows) or "~/.config/StardewValley/Backup/" (macOS)
[*]Copy the directory(check name, years, season, days) that you want to restore from, and paste to the "%APPDATA%\StardewValley\Saves\" (Windows) or "~/.config/StardewValley/Saves/" (macOS)
[*]In the copy window, click Replace All.
[/list]
[b]This Application Is Safe, it doesn't need any Network Connection and it won't collect and report any data from your computer.

And, Thank you for using. if you have any problem please email or leave a comment to me (Email: cloudtronusa@gmail.com)
[/b]
